title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer
raw_text:
### About TechFlow Systems
TechFlow Systems is a leading provider of high-performance data processing solutions for the fintech industry. We build scalable, mission-critical infrastructure that powers some of the world's largest financial institutions.

### The Role
We are looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to join our core platform team. You will be responsible for designing and implementing complex features across our entire stack, from low-latency backend services to intuitive, data-rich frontend applications.

### Responsibilities
- Design, develop, and maintain scalable web applications using React, Node.js, and PostgreSQL.
- Optimize system performance and scalability to handle millions of transactions daily.
- Collaborate with product managers and designers to translate requirements into technical specifications.
- Mentor junior engineers and participate in code reviews to maintain high code quality.
- Implement robust automated testing and CI/CD pipelines.

### Requirements
- 7+ years of professional experience in full-stack web development.
- Deep expertise in React and modern CSS-in-JS libraries.
- Strong proficiency in Node.js and building RESTful or GraphQL APIs.
- Experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and query optimization.
- Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
- Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work in a fast-paced environment.

### Benefits
- Competitive salary and equity package.
- Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance.
- 401(k) with company match.
- Flexible work arrangement (hybrid).
- Generous PTO and parental leave.

title: Technical Product Manager
raw_text:
### About InnovateAI
InnovateAI is an early-stage startup focused on bringing the power of generative AI to enterprise workflows. We are building a suite of tools that help teams automate repetitive tasks and gain deeper insights from their data.

### The Role
As our first Technical Product Manager, you will play a crucial role in shaping the future of our AI platform. You will bridge the gap between our engineering team and our customers, ensuring that we build the right features to solve real-world problems.

### Responsibilities
- Define the product roadmap and prioritize features based on customer feedback and market trends.
- Write detailed technical specifications and user stories for the engineering team.
- Work closely with AI researchers and engineers to understand the capabilities and limitations of our technology.
- Conduct market research and competitive analysis to identify new opportunities.
- Track key product metrics and use data to drive decision-making.

### Requirements
- 4+ years of experience in product management, preferably in a technical or B2B SaaS environment.
- Strong technical background, with a degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience.
- Familiarity with machine learning concepts and natural language processing.
- Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills.
- Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, ambiguous startup environment.
- Experience with Agile development methodologies.

### Benefits
- Opportunity to work at the forefront of AI technology.
- Remote-first culture with flexible working hours.
- Health, dental, and vision insurance.
- Meaningful equity in a growing startup.
- Home office stipend.

title: Backend Software Engineer (Go)
raw_text:

title: Frontend Engineer (React)
raw_text:

PixelPerfect UX is a creative agency that specializes in designing and building beautiful, user-centric digital experiences. We work with a wide range of clients, from startups to Fortune 500 companies, to help them achieve their digital goals.

### The Role
We are looking for a talented Frontend Engineer with a passion for building exceptional user interfaces. You will work closely with our design team to bring their visions to life, creating fast, responsive, and accessible web applications.

### Responsibilities
- Build complex, interactive frontend applications using React and TypeScript.
- Implement responsive designs that look great on all devices.
- Collaborate with UI/UX designers to ensure technical feasibility and high-fidelity implementation.
- Optimize application performance and ensure fast load times.

- 3+ years of professional experience in frontend development.

### Benefits

- Competitive salary and health benefits.
- Flexible work arrangement (hybrid).
- Modern office in downtown Austin.
- Regular team outings and social events.

title: DevOps Engineer
raw_text:
### About DataSafe Corp
DataSafe Corp provides enterprise-grade data security and compliance solutions. Our mission is to help organizations protect their most sensitive data and comply with complex regulations like GDPR and CCPA.

### The Role
As a DevOps Engineer at DataSafe, you will be responsible for managing and automating our infrastructure, ensuring that our systems are secure, scalable, and highly available.

### Responsibilities
- Manage and optimize our cloud infrastructure on AWS.
- Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines to automate software delivery.
- Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting systems to ensure platform stability.
- Collaborate with the engineering team to improve system security and compliance.
- Automate infrastructure provisioning using tools like Terraform or CloudFormation.

### Requirements
- 4+ years of experience in DevOps or SRE roles.
- Strong proficiency with AWS services (EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, EKS).
- Experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Ansible, Pulumi).
- Expertise in building and managing CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins).
- Strong understanding of networking, security, and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
- Proficiency in at least one scripting language (Python, Bash, Go).

### Benefits
- Remote-first culture with a focus on work-life balance.
- Competitive compensation and benefits package.
- Opportunities for professional growth and certifications.
- Modern tech stack and challenging projects.
- Home office equipment allowance.

title: Junior QA Engineer
raw_text:

title: Associate Data Analyst
raw_text:

RetailInsights provides data-driven analytics for the retail industry. We help retailers understand customer behavior, optimize inventory, and increase sales through advanced data modeling.

### The Role
We are seeking an Associate Data Analyst to help us collect, clean, and analyze retail data. You will work closely with our senior analysts to provide actionable insights for our clients.

### Responsibilities
- Extract data from various sources using SQL.
- Clean and transform raw data into a structured format for analysis.
- Create data visualizations and dashboards using tools like Tableau or Power BI.
- Perform exploratory data analysis to identify trends and patterns.
- Assist in the preparation of reports and presentations for clients.

- 1-3 years of experience in data analysis or a related field.
- Proficiency in SQL for data extraction and manipulation.
- Experience with data visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI, Looker).
- Basic understanding of statistical concepts.
- Proficiency in Excel for data analysis.
- Strong communication skills and ability to present findings clearly.

### Benefits
- Remote work environment.
- Opportunities for professional development and training.
- Health, dental, and vision insurance.
- 401(k) retirement plan.
- Collaborative and supportive team.
